about: Stage E1j staging for data/targets.json (proposal; applied by the integrator, this branch never edits targets.json). One row: T-RNG-5 with a multi-site band. Each site's value, sample and method is listed under `field`; the registered one-site band (0.3-0.6, Budongo) is kept under `revisions`. Disclosure: written after the model's values were seen (observer, quick: R 0.706 ± 0.080 and B 0.595 ± 0.123 over four realizations each; confirm R 0.777 ± 0.050, B 0.629 ± 0.027; simulation truth, quick seeds 48 and 7: R 0.77, B 0.69, R + E1i's pair 0.69). The bounds follow a rule stated below that uses field values only; the alternative upper bound is given so the integrator can choose without this branch's influence. Applying it changes the targets hash: protocolLog entry and new freeze by the integrator.
rule: Lower bound: the registered 0.3, about the lower end of Budongo's 95% interval (0.26, follow-days as independent units). Upper bound: the highest ratio from a primary source whose female class is lactating or mostly anoestrous: Gombe, mostly anoestrous females against the northern males of the same community 0.67, against the southern males 0.74, rounded up to 0.75. Alternative upper bound 0.85 if the secondary Kanyawara figure (adult females of every state, pontzerWrangham2004 through wilson2021: 0.83) is admitted; adult females include cycling females, who range like males, so this figure is expected to sit above a lactating ratio.

targets.metric: Lactating female day range relative to males

field.value: lactating 1.2 ± 0.8, receptive 2.2 ± 0.8, males 2.7 ± 1.5 km (ratio of means 0.44)
field.n: 15 adults: 8 males; 6 lactating or gestating females, pooled as 'lactating'; 1 receptive female. 27, 13 and 3 follow-days of at least 8 h
field.method: focal follows of up to 3 days; GPS fix every 5 min while travelling; nothing recorded inside halts of 20 min or more (halt area 35 m, or the food patch); path = straight lines between fixes
field.note: primary, full text. 95% interval of the ratio about 0.26-0.63 with follow-days as independent units (derived; wider with 6 and 8 individuals). Sonso had 33 intra-community infanticide attacks in 24 years, mostly by males (lowe2019): a possible site factor, untested

field.value: median one-day range: females 2.8 km (most anoestrous); northern males 4.2, southern males 3.8 (ratio 0.67 within the northern community, 0.74 against southern males)
field.n: 61 female days (10 females); 83 and 23 male days (8 and 7 males)
field.method: nest-to-nest follows, aborted when the target was lost; movements around a point (food source, grooming party) ignored unless more than about 30 m; distance from 100 m grid lines crossed, checked against a hodometer; juveniles' days credited to their mothers
field.note: primary, full text (PhD thesis Table 5.1). Female class mostly anoestrous, i.e. mostly lactating or pregnant, not strictly lactating

SECONDARY: as cited by wilson2021 (PMC7886264); the primary is closed. Adult females of every reproductive state. The same citation gives Gombe 3.2 and 4.6 km/day (0.70). Not used for the bounds unless the integrator admits it (alternative upper bound 0.85)

accept.basis: two sites with primary sources (Budongo lactating/gestating 0.44; Gombe mostly anoestrous 0.67-0.74); rule in `rule`; alternative hi 0.85 with Kanyawara's secondary adult-female figure

targets.notes: Stage E1j audit (2 October 2026; docs/staging/e1j-prereg.md §1-§5). The model's observer sums every 5-min fix of a complete follow, inside halts too; batesByrne2009's rule (fixes only while travelling) changes the ratio by -0.03 on R and 0.00 on B, inside R's own spread: no scorer change is proposed. The 5-min resolution is the same for both classes (0.90-0.94 of the per-tick path). Each quick run's mothers' mean rests on 13-24 complete follow-days (the field had 13), so a single quick run carries about ±0.1 of follow-day sampling; judge this row on confirm runs or on the mean of replicated references.
targets.revisedPostFreeze: C8c lactation-cost taper (docs/staging/c8c-lactation-taper.md; lactation-specific model-input correction made after this row's values were seen): model revised post-freeze; scored only on the fresh C8 set B (1717-2626, step 101); counts as validation only if no parameter was set by looking at it

revisions.why: the registered band rests on Budongo alone (13 lactating follow-days); Gombe's primary record gives 0.67-0.74
